BANNAN; BANK OF AMERICA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, SUCCESSOR TO FIA CARD SERVICES NA F/K/A MBNA AMERICA BANK; SEABROOK HOUSE, INC., JOHN DOE #1, TENANT AND JANE DOE #1, TENANT
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 1st DAY OF July 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of RAHWAY, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 3.02 BLOCK 292
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
872 LEESVILLE AVENUE RAHWAY, NJ
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: All that certain lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the City of Rahway, County of Union and
State of New Jersey:
Nearest Cross Street: Capobianco Plaza
Union County, New Jersey,
Dimensions:
Amount Due for Taxes:
85.52 feet x 101.11 feet x 84.79 feet x 100.00 feet
Taxes are current through the second quarter 2026.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Office of the Clerk Register of Union County on March 2Q 2004 in Mortgage Book 10599, at Page 501, Instrument No. 305515, and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Union County.
The above figures for taxes were furnished to the Law Firm of Peter J. Liskat LLC by the Tax Collector's Office of the City of Rahway and the accuracy of said figures must be verified by any interested party as Plaintiff makes no representations as to the accuracy of same either express or implied. Accordantly you must check with the Tax Collector to verify the exact amount due.
Subject to any other unpaid taxes, assessments, water and sewer liens, if any.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff of other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any
DISCLAIMER: The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $76,417.00 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: June 5, 2026
PETER J. LISKA, LLC - ATTORNEY
766 SHREWSBURY AVENUE
TINTON FALLS, NJ 07724
